name: Tyler Crump
headline: I design the rules of a game, then build the systems that hold them.
lede: Final-year Game Design and Development student at Macquarie University. I work in Unity and C# on gameplay systems and playtest tooling. On team projects I've also run production: sprints, playtests and the reports that tie them together.
openTo: Open to junior game design, gameplay and tools roles.

start.label: Start here
start.note: I was producer and team leader on this five-person Unity game. I also built its era switch and playtest tooling.

paragraphs: I'm in the final year of a Bachelor of Game Design and Development at Macquarie University, finishing in 2026. The work I enjoy most is making a rule hold up once players start leaning on it: what happens when two eras overlap on the spot you're standing, or which door stays open after a reload.

On team projects I've usually been the one holding the plan: sprint planning, retrospectives, client emails and playtest sessions. On my own I've designed a two-fighter combat kit in Ikemen GO and built a group trip planner whose first real test was a group trip to Japan.
